mentions.name: Homelore
mentions.description: A Carfax-like service for homes that generates historical narrative reports about a home's history, intended to inspire people to care about their home's history rather than to serve as a pre-purchase inspection tool. Positioned to help realtors encourage buyers to take on historic homes and for homeowners interested in their home's story.
mentions.problem: Pre-1800 homes need preservation and promotion, and buyers are often hesitant to take on historic homes that may need a lot of work.
mentions.audience: Realtors who want to inspire buyers to take on historic homes that may need a lot of work, as well as homeowners themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The main thing I'm working on to that effect is https://homelore.org

It's like a carfax but for your home, although the intention is more to create an interesting historical narrative that inspires people to care about the history of their home rather than as a tool for inspecting home issues before buying.
